manga.title: Manga ingest
manga.description: Ingest from Telegram discussion albums. Images go to the image host, then the manga site. Channel forwarding uses the existing rules. E-Hentai and HMW publish live in the sidebar child pages.
manga.configHint: Secrets show only their configured state; leaving a secret field empty keeps the saved value.
manga.enableHint: When enabled, the service connects to Telegram and listens to the configured chats on startup.
manga.aiHint: Use the model from Settings to clean title cards: drop template lines, extract title/author/tags. Edit the prompt here if results go wrong—no code change needed.
manga.aiNeedModel: No usable AI model yet. Add a key in Settings first.
manga.aiPrompt: Prompt (leave empty for the built-in default)
manga.aiPromptPlaceholder: Return JSON only: title / author / tags / skip
manga.aiPromptHint: Edit the instructions only. The caption is attached by the pipeline. Empty restores the built-in prompt.
manga.sourceChatsHint: Each collection channel maps to one discussion group.
manga.sourceBindingsHint: Discussion albums listen to the linked group and may backfill history on start. Telegraph / online-read posts are ingested only when they have an “在线阅读” or “view on Telegraph” button; posts without that button are skipped. New channels catch up the latest batch, then continue from the last seen post. An empty discussion with Auto uses this mode.
manga.skipIngestHint: When checked, this channel is not watched. Already ingested manga stay.
manga.accountHint: Pick a signed-in Telegram account from /accounts. Login, proxy, and session stay on the accounts page.
manga.noAccounts: No accounts yet. Add and sign in the ingest account on /accounts first.
manga.allowedSendersHint: Optional. When set, only these Telegram sender IDs are accepted.
manga.idleSeconds: Chapter idle window (seconds; discussion threads wait longer so slow uploads stay in one chapter)
manga.maxPages: Maximum pages per chapter (1–10000; use 2000 for long IF-style chapters)
manga.outboundEnable: Forward new chapters to a channel
manga.outboundHint: New chapters post manga previews first (images, title, author, tags, and a read link). Story videos follow when enabled and never go to the site. A bot token sends the album; otherwise the ingest account posts. The bot or ingest account must admin the channel.
manga.outboundForwardVideosHint: When on, the manga preview is posted first and any mp4 follows. Videos are copied inside Telegram, not downloaded to this server. The site stays image-only.
manga.bindingForwardVideos: Forward videos from this source channel
manga.videoBlockKeywordsPlaceholder:
One per line, e.g.
ad spam
unrelated drama
manga.videoBlockKeywordsHint: Skip videos whose title or caption contains these words.
manga.videoAllowKeywordsPlaceholder: Leave empty for no allow-list. If set, a video must match one word.
manga.videoAllowKeywordsHint: Use this to keep only certain videos, e.g. story, anime.
manga.outboundSiteBase: Reader site origin (optional; defaults to the site publish host)
manga.outboundBotTokenPlaceholder: 123456:ABC…  uses the bot and a real button
manga.catalogHint: Review ingested works and page counts, then open the public site from each item.
manga.ehentaiHint: Turn on continuous listening to search for new galleries on an interval. You do not need to click ingest each time. Pages go to the image host, then the manga site. Telegraph is not used. Cookies stay on the server.
manga.ehentaiPageHint: Same idea as channel ingest: flip the switch and it keeps listening. Queries are polled for new galleries and resume after a restart. Image host and site publishing stay on Channel ingest.
manga.ehentaiSharedConfigHint: Image host, site publish URL, and outbound channel settings are shared with Telegram ingest and are not duplicated here.
manga.ehentaiEnableHint: When on, new galleries are searched on the interval below and again after a restart. Turn off to stop listening.
manga.ehentaiRunOnceHint: Skip the wait and search again immediately. Continuous listening must be on.
manga.ehentaiCookieSaved: Saved on the server (leave the box empty)
manga.ehentaiCookieHint: Paste the e-hentai / exhentai cookie from your browser. Required for ExHentai. An empty password box still means the saved cookie is kept.
manga.ehentaiExhentaiHint: Use exhentai.org when the sadpanda cookie is present; otherwise e-hentai.org.
manga.ehentaiSearchPlaceholder:
One query per line, e.g.
3d language:Chinese
female:NTR language:Chinese
milf language:Chinese
manga.ehentaiSearchHint: Same syntax as the site search box. Prefer adding language:Chinese. Split by comma or newline.
manga.ehentaiCatsHint: The old crawler used 704 (hide Non-H / Image Set / Asian Porn). 0 means all categories.
manga.ehentaiPoll: Listen interval (seconds after a full pass)
manga.ehentaiRecentHint: Ingested galleries as cover cards, same layout as the channel catalog. The link opens the site or gallery.
manga.ehentaiTranslationHint: Same dataset as EhTagTranslation (editor: ehtt.vercel.app/list/all). Update downloads the latest db.text.json and keeps Chinese names only. Startup can check the Git SHA.
manga.ehentaiTranslationAuto: Check for updates when ingest starts
manga.ehentaiTranslationAutoHint: Skip the download when the remote Git SHA matches. “Update dictionary” always refreshes.
manga.ehentaiTranslationUrlHint: Defaults to DatabaseReleases db.text.json via jsDelivr, then GitHub. Set a full URL to use a mirror.
manga.hmwPageHint: Drop zip / 7z or extracted folders into data/hmw/inbox, or pull archives from a Telegram chat. Scan chapters, preflight, then convert to AVIF and publish to HMW.
manga.hmwInboxHint: On Docker the host path is ./data/hmw/inbox. Archives larger than 200MB should be copied there instead of browser upload.
manga.hmwAlbumHint: Paste a t.me link with comment=. Images are saved under inbox as series/chapter folders. Use the document list below for zip/7z files.
manga.hmwAlbumFailed: Failed to pull the discussion album
manga.hmwLibraryHint: Search published titles. Selecting one appends new local chapters; existing numbers are skipped by default.
manga.hmwCatalogHint: Local history of titles published to HMW, with the same cover cards as channel ingest. Open a card to edit metadata, renumber chapters, or delete.
manga.hmwCatalogEmpty: No local publish history yet. Titles appear after a successful publish, or sync existing works from the site.
manga.hmwManageHint: Edit title, slug, author, status and synopsis. The chapter table changes numbers and titles. Delete removes the HMW page and CDN files.
manga.hmwDeleteMangaConfirm: Delete this manga and every chapter? The site entry and stored images will be removed.
manga.hmwDeleteChapterConfirm: Delete chapter {number}? Its pages will be removed from HMW.
manga.hmwAppendHowTo: To add the next chapter: click “Append chapters”, then drop the new chapter folder into inbox or paste a discussion album link. Existing numbers are skipped. Local images are deleted after a successful publish.
manga.hmwAppendReady: Selected “{title}” ({count} chapters live). Scan a new folder or album to append.

coser.title: Coser publish
coser.pageHint: Pull a Telegram post, upload gallery images to the S3 bucket configured on this page, disguise and upload the archive with the same cloud accounts as games, then publish to icoser.de.
coser.configHint: Admin credentials call the icoser.de API. Gallery images upload directly to the S3 settings below. Cloud cookies/tokens are shared with game publish; only remote folders are overridden here.
coser.cloudReuseHint: Cloud logins are managed on the game publish page.
coser.s3PrefixHint: Object key template: prefix/coser-name/workId+safeTitle/001.avif, e.g. coser/rioko/538rem_cosplay/001.avif. Title characters ()（）+&#%[]【】 and spaces are stripped so S3 and public URLs stay valid.
coser.telegramUrlInvalid: Enter a full t.me post URL
coser.pullHint: Pull images and archives. Images upload to the S3 bucket on this page; archives go to cloud drives.

games.title: Game publish
games.pageHint: Watch Telegram and process one game at a time, strip ads, split large archives, disguise each Baidu volume, upload folders, and publish.
games.cloudKeepaliveHint: Every {hours} hours the panel pings configured drives and writes back refreshed cookies/tokens so they do not expire.
games.wpVipHint: Gold and Diamond VIP can have their own prices. Leave empty to match the regular price; 0 means free for that level.
games.wpPayExtraHint: Editable template. {pack_password} is the archive password, {extract} is the auto-generated share code, {apate} is the Apate link. Do not hard-code the extract code.
games.payModoHint: Zibll allows one type per post: balance/cash, or points.
games.noAccounts: No accounts yet. Add and sign in the ingest account on /accounts first.
games.automationHint: Watch new posts and always process one game and upload one file at a time. Saving applies the settings.
games.automationNotReady: Auto publishing is not fully configured
games.automationRetryRequested: Failed items returned to the queue
games.aiHint: Use the model from Settings to clean channel posts: title, summary, tags, categories. Auto-publish can skip posts that are not games. Edit the prompt here if results go wrong.
games.aiNeedModel: No usable AI model yet. Add a key in Settings first.
games.aiSkipNonGames: Skip posts the AI marks as not a game during auto-publish
games.aiPrompt: Prompt (leave empty for the built-in default)
games.aiPromptPlaceholder: Return JSON only: title / summary / tags / category_ids / skip
games.aiPromptHint: Edit the instructions only. The original caption is attached by the pipeline. Empty restores the built-in prompt.
games.telegramBackfillHint: Set to 0 to record the current position without publishing channel history.
games.baiduDirHint: Uploads go to remote-dir/pinyin-initials/, e.g. /网站/ixacg/game/yngddhymwy. Only that child folder is created under the configured path.
games.configHint: Unpack/repack passwords are shown in plain text. Cloud secrets stay on the server. Use direct cookies/tokens for Baidu/PikPak/TeraBox/Quark, or OpenList paths. Share extract codes are a random 4 characters per publish. Cloud cookies/tokens are refreshed automatically.
games.pullHint: Paste a full channel post URL such as https://t.me/Zhzbzx/19706?single. The whole album and attachments will be downloaded.
games.telegramUrlInvalid: Paste a full post URL with channel and message id, e.g. t.me/Zhzbzx/19706?single
games.draftApate: Apate disguise before Baidu / Quark upload
games.uploadCloudsHint: Only checked drives are uploaded this time. Manual links apply to checked drives only.
games.manualLinks: Manual share links (skip auto-upload when set)
games.noArchives: No archive yet — pull a post or upload a file
